newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to issue $143 million in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to issue $143 million in bonds.

text.p: Paraguay's Chamber of Deputies Thursday authorized the government to issue $143 million worth of bonds, $50 million of which to be placed before the end of this year.
"The bond issues will have maturities between two and five years in local currency or dollars," Benicio Sanchez, of the Central Bank's open market division, told Reuters.
The first of the issues will be placed by the Central Bank directly with banks operating in the country in the next 10 to 15 days, said Sanchez.
The remainder of the debt will be placed at the beginning of 1997 on the local stock exchange.
The funds from the bonds will be used to finance public works and assistance programs to municipalities and agricultural producers.
No official indication was given of the bonds' yield.
